-- Solo License schema. One file, applied idempotently at startup.
-- Pragmas: enforce referential integrity and durable, concurrent reads.
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;

-- Legacy: the payments agent's tables (orders, license_state, runs,
-- policies, policy_rules, policy_impacts, execution_permits, detections,
-- license_events, armed_faults, intakes, tickets) stay for one release so
-- older databases keep opening. Only the startup migration in database.py
-- touches them; the app reads settings, spans and the agent_* tables.

-- The "real world" the agent acts on. orders.refunded_amount is the ONLY
-- authority on whether a refund actually landed - the verifier reads it
-- back after every execution rather than trusting the tool's response.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
    order_id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    customer         TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount           REAL NOT NULL,            -- original order total
    refunded_amount  REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- verified side effect (refund)
    credit_issued    REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- verified side effect (store_credit)
    status           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'paid',
    updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
    -- email, ordered_at, currency, source, external_id, customer_ref are
    -- added by database._migrate so older databases gain them too.
);

-- The autonomy dial. One row per task class; the live source of truth the
-- UI renders and the agent consults before acting.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS license_state (
    task_class             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    level                  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- LicenseLevel
    consecutive_clean_runs INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    quarantined            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- 0/1
    demoted_from           INTEGER,                     -- level it fell from
    successes              INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- verified evidence
    failures               INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- One row per refund run. Carries the before/after numbers that make a
-- neatlogs trace comparison concrete, plus the trace id for deep-linking.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    task_class       TEXT NOT NULL,
    order_id         TEXT NOT NULL,
    requested_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    level_at_run     INTEGER NOT NULL,         -- effective level when decided
    decision         TEXT NOT NULL,            -- Decision name
    status           TEXT NOT NULL,            -- RunStatus value
    executed         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    before_refunded  REAL NOT NULL,            -- orders.refunded_amount before
    after_refunded   REAL NOT NULL,            -- orders.refunded_amount after
    idempotency_key  TEXT,
    actor_id         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system:license-service',
    actor_role       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin',
    policy_version   INTEGER,
    fault_mode       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
    trace_id         TEXT,
    notes            TEXT,
    created_at       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (order_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_runs_created ON runs (created_at DESC);
-- idx_runs_idempotency_executed is created in database._migrate_runs, after
-- older databases have gained the idempotency_key column.

-- Immutable workspace policy versions. Only one version is active at a time;
-- runs retain the version that governed their authorization and evaluation.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS policies (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    version     INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    status      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'superseded')),
    summary     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_by  TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_policies_one_active
    ON policies (status) WHERE status = 'active';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS policy_rules (
    id                              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    policy_id                       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    task_class                      TEXT NOT NULL,
    allowed_tool                    TEXT NOT NULL,
    requires_approval_at_or_above   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    l2_ceiling                      REAL NOT NULL,
    evaluation_window               INTEGER NOT NULL,
    minimum_samples                 INTEGER NOT NULL,
    minimum_verified_pass_rate      REAL NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (policy_id) REFERENCES policies (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE (policy_id, task_class)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_policy_rules_policy ON policy_rules (policy_id, task_class);

-- Policies are append-only audit records. The only legal transition is active
-- -> superseded during creation of a newer version; rules are never edited.
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS policies_immutable_fields
BEFORE UPDATE OF version, name, summary, created_by, created_at ON policies
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'policy versions are immutable');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS policies_status_transition
BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON policies
WHEN OLD.status != 'active' OR NEW.status != 'superseded'
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'policy status transition is immutable');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS policies_immutable_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON policies
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'policy versions are immutable');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS policy_rules_immutable_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON policy_rules
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'policy rules are immutable');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS policy_rules_immutable_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON policy_rules
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'policy rules are immutable');
END;

-- A policy activation records why each current license state is held for
-- review or remains eligible. It never silently changes the license level.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS policy_impacts (
    id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    previous_version    INTEGER,
    next_version        INTEGER NOT NULL,
    task_class          TEXT NOT NULL,
    available_samples   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    required_samples    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pass_rate           REAL NOT NULL,
    required_pass_rate  REAL NOT NULL,
    action              TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason              TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_policy_impacts_version ON policy_impacts (next_version, task_class);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS policy_impacts_immutable_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON policy_impacts
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'policy impacts are immutable');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS policy_impacts_immutable_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON policy_impacts
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'policy impacts are immutable');
END;

-- Only the hash of a server-issued tool authorization is stored. A conditional
-- update consumes it exactly once immediately before a side effect is written.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS execution_permits (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    permit_digest   TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    policy_version  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    task_class      TEXT NOT NULL,
    tool            TEXT NOT NULL,
    order_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount          REAL NOT NULL,
    actor_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    issued_at       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    expires_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    consumed_at     TEXT,
    disposition     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'issued'
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_execution_permits_pending
    ON execution_permits (permit_digest, expires_at) WHERE consumed_at IS NULL;

-- Detections surfaced as incidents. Each row is one rule firing on one run.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS detections (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    run_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rule        TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- e.g. state_mismatch
    severity    TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- info | warning | critical
    message     TEXT NOT NULL,
    trace_id    TEXT,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_detections_run ON detections (run_id);

-- The git-backed license ledger. Every promote / demote / restore is a row
-- here AND a git commit; git_sha links the two so Entire can graph/explain
-- the history of autonomy changes.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS license_events (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    task_class  TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind        TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- promote | demote | restore
    from_level  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    to_level    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reason      TEXT NOT NULL,
    run_id      INTEGER,
    actor_id    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system:license-service',
    actor_role  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin',
    git_sha     TEXT,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES runs (id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_license_events_class ON license_events (task_class, created_at DESC);

-- Local mirror of observability spans, written for every run so the evidence
-- packet and before/after comparison work even with no neatlogs key present.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spans (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    trace_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    run_id      INTEGER,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    attributes  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',    -- JSON
    status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ok',
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spans_trace ON spans (trace_id);

-- Armed fault for the next run of a task class. The UI sets a row here; the
-- worker consumes and clears it, so a fault deterministically affects exactly
-- one run. Default 'none' means run normally.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS armed_faults (
    task_class  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    mode        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
    updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- Operator-editable settings (onboarding + the Settings screen). Values here
-- override environment defaults at startup; secrets are never echoed to the UI.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
    key         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value       TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- Free-text customer requests handled by the intake agent.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intakes (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    message     TEXT NOT NULL,
    order_id    TEXT,
    amount      REAL,
    reason      TEXT,
    source      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deterministic',
    run_id      INTEGER,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- Customer messages waiting for (or handled by) the agent. They arrive by
-- paste, by the inbox webhook (helpdesk / email forwarder) or by CSV import.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tickets (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    source      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'paste',   -- paste | webhook | sample
    sender      TEXT,                            -- customer email, if known
    subject     TEXT,
    body        TEXT NOT NULL,
    status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',     -- new | done | waiting | declined | needs_info | needs_human | answered
    outcome     TEXT,                            -- one-line result for the inbox
    reply       TEXT,                            -- reply drafted for the customer
    steps       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',      -- JSON: the agent's steps
    run_id      INTEGER,
    trace_id    TEXT,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    handled_at  TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tickets_created ON tickets (created_at DESC);

-- Coding agents ------------------------------------------------------------
-- One license per (repository, action class): `npm test` earns `test-run` in
-- this repo only. Levels: 0 ask every time, 1 auto-allow command families a
-- person already approved here, 2 auto-allow the whole class.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_licenses (
    repo          TEXT NOT NULL,
    principal     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main', -- main | subagent:<type>
    action_class  TEXT NOT NULL,
    level         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    successes     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   -- verified outcomes at any level
    failures      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    successes_at_level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- since the last level change
    demoted_from  INTEGER,
    updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    PRIMARY KEY (repo, principal, action_class)
);

-- Command families a person approved in a repo (what level 1 auto-allows).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_patterns (
    repo          TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_class  TEXT NOT NULL,
    pattern       TEXT NOT NULL,
    approvals     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (repo, pattern)
);

-- Every gate decision and what came of it.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_decisions (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    agent         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude-code',
    principal     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main', -- main | subagent:<type>
    turn_id       INTEGER,
    repo          TEXT NOT NULL,
    tool_name     TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_class  TEXT NOT NULL,
    pattern       TEXT NOT NULL,
    command       TEXT NOT NULL,
    decision      TEXT NOT NULL,                -- allow | ask | deny
    decided_by    TEXT NOT NULL,                -- license | person | hard-deny | classifier
    level         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    source        TEXT NOT NULL,                -- rules | jev | fallback
    reason        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', -- pending | ran | verified | failed | denied | not-run
    trace_id      TEXT,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_decisions_session ON agent_decisions (session_id, id DESC);

-- One user prompt and the turn of work it started; verified at Stop.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_turns (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    agent         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude-code',
    principal     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main', -- main | subagent:<type>
    repo          TEXT NOT NULL,
    cwd           TEXT NOT NULL,
    prompt        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    base_ref      TEXT,                         -- working tree snapshot at the prompt
    status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', -- open | verified | blocked | failed
    scope_score   INTEGER,
    lines_changed INTEGER,
    files_changed INTEGER,
    tests         TEXT,                         -- passed | failed | none
    reason        TEXT,
    trace_id      TEXT,
    entire_checkpoint TEXT,                     -- last Entire checkpoint before a failure
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    closed_at     TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_turns_session ON agent_turns (session_id, id DESC);

-- Per-repository settings (the command that verifies a turn).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_repos (
    repo          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    path          TEXT NOT NULL,
    test_command  TEXT,
    last_tests    TEXT,                         -- passed | failed at the last turn check
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- This machine's coding policy, per repository or for all ("*"). It can only
-- tighten the built-in rules and the repository's .solo-license/policy.toml.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_policies (
    repo        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    body        TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- JSON: classes / deny / freeze
    updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

-- Every change to a coding agent's license (promote | demote | restore | policy),
-- per repository and principal. Each row is also a commit in the license ledger.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_events (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    repo          TEXT NOT NULL,
    principal     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main',  -- main | subagent:<type>
    action_class  TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- or 'policy' for a policy change
    kind          TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_level    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    to_level      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reason        TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    git_sha       TEXT,
    trace_id      TEXT,                          -- the neatlogs trace that recorded the change
    entire_checkpoint TEXT,                      -- the agent's last Entire checkpoint, when known
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_events_repo ON agent_events (repo, id DESC);

-- What the agent was told to undo. Sent with the hook answer (delivered_at
-- set) or queued for the session's next prompt (delivered_at NULL until then).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_remediations (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    session_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    turn_id       INTEGER,
    kind          TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- tool-failed | turn-failed | denied | flagged
    text          TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    delivered_at  TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_remediations_session ON agent_remediations (session_id, delivered_at);

-- Rolling per-session fingerprints of tool calls (loop detection). Repeat
-- counters reset on every edit; 'edit:<turn>:<path>' rows count edits per file;
-- a 'halt' row refuses the session's calls until its turn ends or a new prompt.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_fingerprints (
    session_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    fingerprint   TEXT NOT NULL,
    count         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    failures      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,    -- consecutive failures with the same error
    last_outcome  TEXT,                          -- ok | failed
    last_error    TEXT,
    seq           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,    -- recency within the session window
    updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    PRIMARY KEY (session_id, fingerprint)
);

-- A person said a decision or a turn was wrong. Its classes went back to L0
-- and the session's next prompt carries the remediation.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_flags (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    decision_id    INTEGER,
    turn_id        INTEGER,
    actor_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason         TEXT NOT NULL,
    remediation_id INTEGER,                      -- the queued message for the agent
    created_at     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    delivered_at   TEXT
);

"""Connection management and schema application.

A thin wrapper over the stdlib ``sqlite3`` module: it hands out connections
configured for safe concurrent use and applies the schema idempotently. All
SQL for the app lives in the repository modules that sit on top of this."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

_SCHEMA_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("schema.sql")


def connect(db_path: Path, *, check_same_thread: bool = True) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open a connection with sensible defaults.

    * ``row_factory`` yields dict-like rows for readable call sites.
    * foreign keys are enforced per-connection (SQLite requires this each time).
    * ``check_same_thread=False`` lets a Streamlit cached resource reuse one
      connection across the framework's worker threads (demo serialises writes).
    """
    db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(
        db_path,
        detect_types=sqlite3.PARSE_DECLTYPES,
        check_same_thread=check_same_thread,
    )
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


def apply_schema(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """Create every table/index if absent. Safe to call on every startup."""
    conn.executescript(_SCHEMA_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    _migrate_runs(conn)
    _migrate_v3(conn)
    _migrate_principals(conn)
    conn.commit()


def _migrate_v3(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """Coding events used to share ``license_events`` with the payments agent
    (as ``<class>@<repo>``). Copy them into ``agent_events`` the first time."""
    if conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM agent_events LIMIT 1").fetchone():
        return
    if not conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'license_events'").fetchone():
        return
    conn.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO agent_events (repo, action_class, kind, from_level, to_level, reason, actor_id, git_sha, created_at)
        SELECT substr(task_class, instr(task_class, '@') + 1), substr(task_class, 1, instr(task_class, '@') - 1),
               kind, from_level, to_level, reason, actor_id, git_sha, created_at
          FROM license_events WHERE task_class LIKE '%@%' ORDER BY id
        """
    )


def _migrate_principals(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """Add principal identity to coding state without losing old licenses.

    ``agent_licenses`` used ``(repo, action_class)`` as its primary key, so
    SQLite cannot add the new key with ``ALTER TABLE``. Rebuild that one table
    when opening a pre-v3 database; the other tables only need nullable-free
    defaulted columns.
    """
    license_columns = {row["name"] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(agent_licenses)")}
    if "principal" not in license_columns:
        conn.execute("ALTER TABLE agent_licenses RENAME TO agent_licenses_legacy")
        conn.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE agent_licenses (
                repo TEXT NOT NULL,
                principal TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main',
                action_class TEXT NOT NULL,
                level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                successes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                successes_at_level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                demoted_from INTEGER,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                PRIMARY KEY (repo, principal, action_class)
            )
            """
        )
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO agent_licenses
                (repo, principal, action_class, level, successes, failures,
                 successes_at_level, demoted_from, updated_at)
            SELECT repo, 'main', action_class, level, successes, failures,
                   successes_at_level, demoted_from, updated_at
              FROM agent_licenses_legacy
            """
        )
        conn.execute("DROP TABLE agent_licenses_legacy")

    for table in ("agent_decisions", "agent_turns"):
        columns = {row["name"] for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")}
        if "principal" not in columns:
            conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN principal TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main'")


_ADDED_COLUMNS = {
    "orders": (
        ("credit_issued", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("email", "TEXT"),
        ("ordered_at", "TEXT"),                     # ISO date the customer paid
        ("currency", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'usd'"),
        ("source", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual'"),  # manual | sample | csv | stripe
        ("external_id", "TEXT"),                    # e.g. Stripe charge id
        ("customer_ref", "TEXT"),                   # e.g. Stripe customer id
    ),
    "license_state": (
        ("successes", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("failures", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
    ),
    "runs": (
        ("recovered", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),   # agent fixed a failed action
        ("ticket_id", "INTEGER"),
    ),
    "tickets": (
        ("follows_ticket_id", "INTEGER"),          # the earlier message this one answers
    ),
    "agent_turns": (
        ("entire_checkpoint", "TEXT"),             # last Entire checkpoint before a failure
        ("agent", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude-code'"),  # which coding agent
        ("principal", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main'"),
    ),
    "agent_decisions": (
        ("agent", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude-code'"),
        ("principal", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'main'"),
    ),
    "agent_repos": (
        ("last_tests", "TEXT"),                    # passed | failed at the last turn check
    ),
    "agent_events": (
        ("trace_id", "TEXT"),                      # the neatlogs trace that recorded the change
        ("entire_checkpoint", "TEXT"),             # the agent's last Entire checkpoint
    ),
}


def _migrate_runs(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    for table, columns in _ADDED_COLUMNS.items():
        existing = {row["name"] for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")}
        for name, ddl in columns:
            if name not in existing:
                conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {name} {ddl}")
    columns = {row["name"] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(runs)")}
    if "idempotency_key" not in columns:
        conn.execute("ALTER TABLE runs ADD COLUMN idempotency_key TEXT")
    if "actor_id" not in columns:
        conn.execute("ALTER TABLE runs ADD COLUMN actor_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system:license-service'")
    if "actor_role" not in columns:
        conn.execute("ALTER TABLE runs ADD COLUMN actor_role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin'")
    if "policy_version" not in columns:
        conn.execute("ALTER TABLE runs ADD COLUMN policy_version INTEGER")
    event_columns = {row["name"] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(license_events)")}
    if "actor_id" not in event_columns:
        conn.execute("ALTER TABLE license_events ADD COLUMN actor_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system:license-service'")
    if "actor_role" not in event_columns:
        conn.execute("ALTER TABLE license_events ADD COLUMN actor_role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin'")
    conn.execute(
        """
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_runs_idempotency_executed
            ON runs (idempotency_key)
            WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND executed = 1
        """
    )


def init_db(db_path: Path, *, check_same_thread: bool = True) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open a connection and guarantee the schema exists."""
    conn = connect(db_path, check_same_thread=check_same_thread)
    apply_schema(conn)
    return conn

"""Coding-agent licenses, decisions and turns. The caller commits."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3


# --- licenses ----------------------------------------------------------------

def get_license(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str, *, principal: str = "main") -> sqlite3.Row:
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO agent_licenses (repo, principal, action_class) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (repo, principal, action_class),
    )
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_licenses WHERE repo = ? AND principal = ? AND action_class = ?",
        (repo, principal, action_class),
    ).fetchone()


def effective_license(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str, principal: str,
                     *, max_level: int = 1, create: bool = True) -> dict:
    """Return a principal's license, inheriting the repo license at a ceiling.

    Main-agent rows are the source of truth for the repository. A subagent gets
    its own row once it has evidence; before that, it inherits the main row but
    can never exceed ``max_level``.
    """
    if principal == "main":
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM agent_licenses WHERE repo = ? AND principal = 'main' AND action_class = ?",
            (repo, action_class),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is not None:
            return dict(row)
        if create:
            return dict(get_license(conn, repo, action_class))
        return {"repo": repo, "principal": "main", "action_class": action_class,
                "level": 0, "successes": 0, "failures": 0, "successes_at_level": 0,
                "demoted_from": None, "updated_at": None}
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_licenses WHERE repo = ? AND principal = ? AND action_class = ?",
        (repo, principal, action_class),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is not None:
        result = dict(row)
        result["level"] = min(int(result["level"]), max_level)
        return result
    inherited_row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_licenses WHERE repo = ? AND principal = 'main' AND action_class = ?",
        (repo, action_class),
    ).fetchone()
    if inherited_row is None and create:
        inherited_row = get_license(conn, repo, action_class, principal="main")
    inherited = dict(inherited_row) if inherited_row is not None else {
        "repo": repo, "principal": "main", "action_class": action_class,
        "level": 0, "successes": 0, "failures": 0, "successes_at_level": 0,
        "demoted_from": None, "updated_at": None,
    }
    inherited["principal"] = principal
    inherited["level"] = min(int(inherited["level"]), max_level)
    return inherited


def list_licenses(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    if repo is None:
        return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_licenses ORDER BY repo, principal, action_class").fetchall()
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_licenses WHERE repo = ? ORDER BY principal, action_class", (repo,)
    ).fetchall()


def add_evidence(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str, *, ok: bool,
                 principal: str = "main") -> None:
    get_license(conn, repo, action_class, principal=principal)  # create the row on first evidence
    change = ("successes = successes + 1, successes_at_level = successes_at_level + 1"
              if ok else "failures = failures + 1")
    conn.execute(
        f"UPDATE agent_licenses SET {change}, updated_at = datetime('now') "
        "WHERE repo = ? AND principal = ? AND action_class = ?",
        (repo, principal, action_class),
    )


def set_level(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str, level: int,
              *, demoted_from: int | None = None, principal: str = "main") -> None:
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE agent_licenses SET level = ?, demoted_from = ?, successes_at_level = 0, "
        "updated_at = datetime('now') "
        "WHERE repo = ? AND principal = ? AND action_class = ?",
        (level, demoted_from, repo, principal, action_class),
    )


# --- approved command families --------------------------------------------------

def approve_pattern(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str, pattern: str) -> None:
    conn.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO agent_patterns (repo, action_class, pattern, approvals) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)
        ON CONFLICT (repo, pattern) DO UPDATE SET approvals = approvals + 1
        """,
        (repo, action_class, pattern),
    )


def pattern_approved(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT approvals FROM agent_patterns WHERE repo = ? AND pattern = ?", (repo, pattern)
    ).fetchone()
    return bool(row and row["approvals"] > 0)


def forget_patterns(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str) -> None:
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM agent_patterns WHERE repo = ? AND action_class = ?", (repo, action_class))


# --- decisions -------------------------------------------------------------

DECISION_COLUMNS = frozenset({
    "session_id", "agent", "principal", "turn_id", "repo", "tool_name", "action_class", "pattern", "command",
    "decision", "decided_by", "level", "source", "reason", "outcome", "trace_id",
})


def insert_decision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, **fields) -> int:
    """Column names come only from this fixed list; values are always bound."""
    unknown = set(fields) - DECISION_COLUMNS
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown agent_decisions columns: {sorted(unknown)}")
    keys = ", ".join(fields)
    marks = ", ".join("?" for _ in fields)
    cur = conn.execute(f"INSERT INTO agent_decisions ({keys}) VALUES ({marks})", tuple(fields.values()))
    return int(cur.lastrowid)


def pending_decision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str, tool_name: str, command: str,
                     *, principal: str = "main") -> sqlite3.Row | None:
    """The latest gate decision this tool run belongs to (PermissionRequest
    carries no tool_use_id, so the session, tool and command identify it)."""
    return conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT * FROM agent_decisions
         WHERE session_id = ? AND principal = ? AND tool_name = ? AND command = ? AND outcome = 'pending'
         ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
        """,
        (session_id, principal, tool_name, command),
    ).fetchone()


def set_outcome(conn: sqlite3.Connection, decision_id: int, outcome: str, *, decided_by: str | None = None) -> None:
    if decided_by:
        conn.execute("UPDATE agent_decisions SET outcome = ?, decided_by = ? WHERE id = ?",
                     (outcome, decided_by, decision_id))
    else:
        conn.execute("UPDATE agent_decisions SET outcome = ? WHERE id = ?", (outcome, decision_id))


def decisions_for_turn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_decisions WHERE turn_id = ? ORDER BY id", (turn_id,)).fetchall()


def recent_decisions(conn: sqlite3.Connection, limit: int = 50) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_decisions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()


# --- turns ---------------------------------------------------------------

def open_turn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, session_id: str, repo: str, cwd: str, prompt: str,
              base_ref: str | None, trace_id: str | None, agent: str = "claude-code",
              principal: str = "main") -> int:
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO agent_turns (session_id, agent, principal, repo, cwd, prompt, base_ref, trace_id) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (session_id, agent, principal, repo, cwd, prompt, base_ref, trace_id),
    )
    return int(cur.lastrowid)


def current_turn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_turns WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1", (session_id,)
    ).fetchone()


TURN_CLOSE_COLUMNS = frozenset({"status", "reason", "scope_score", "lines_changed", "files_changed", "tests"})


def close_turn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int, **fields) -> None:
    """Column names come only from this fixed list; values are always bound."""
    unknown = set(fields) - TURN_CLOSE_COLUMNS
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown agent_turns columns: {sorted(unknown)}")
    sets = ", ".join(f"{k} = ?" for k in fields)
    conn.execute(f"UPDATE agent_turns SET {sets}, closed_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?",
                 (*fields.values(), turn_id))


def note_block(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int, reason: str) -> None:
    """Remember why a turn was sent back; it stays open to be checked again."""
    conn.execute("UPDATE agent_turns SET reason = ?, scope_score = scope_score WHERE id = ?", (reason, turn_id))


def set_checkpoint(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int, checkpoint_id: str) -> None:
    conn.execute("UPDATE agent_turns SET entire_checkpoint = ? WHERE id = ?", (checkpoint_id, turn_id))


def get_turn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_turns WHERE id = ?", (turn_id,)).fetchone()


def agents_seen(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    """Each coding agent that has called the gate, and when it last did."""
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT agent, COUNT(*) AS decisions, MAX(created_at) AS last_seen "
        "FROM agent_decisions GROUP BY agent ORDER BY last_seen DESC"
    ).fetchall()


def recent_turns(conn: sqlite3.Connection, limit: int = 30) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_turns ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()


# --- events ------------------------------------------------------------------

def insert_event(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, repo: str, action_class: str, kind: str, from_level: int,
                 to_level: int, reason: str, actor_id: str, principal: str = "main",
                 trace_id: str | None = None, entire_checkpoint: str | None = None) -> int:
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO agent_events (repo, principal, action_class, kind, from_level, to_level, reason, actor_id, "
        "trace_id, entire_checkpoint) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (repo, principal, action_class, kind, from_level, to_level, reason, actor_id, trace_id, entire_checkpoint),
    )
    return int(cur.lastrowid)


def set_event_sha(conn: sqlite3.Connection, event_id: int, git_sha: str) -> None:
    conn.execute("UPDATE agent_events SET git_sha = ? WHERE id = ?", (git_sha, event_id))


def list_events(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str | None = None, limit: int = 60) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    if repo is None:
        return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_events WHERE repo = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (repo, limit)
    ).fetchall()


# --- remediations --------------------------------------------------------------

def queue_remediation(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, session_id: str, turn_id: int | None, kind: str, text: str,
                      delivered: bool = False) -> int:
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO agent_remediations (session_id, turn_id, kind, text, delivered_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, CASE WHEN ? THEN datetime('now') END)",
        (session_id, turn_id, kind, text, int(delivered)),
    )
    return int(cur.lastrowid)


def take_remediations(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    """The session's queued remediations, oldest first, marked delivered."""
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_remediations WHERE session_id = ? AND delivered_at IS NULL ORDER BY id", (session_id,)
    ).fetchall()
    if rows:
        ids = [(r["id"],) for r in rows]
        conn.executemany("UPDATE agent_remediations SET delivered_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?", ids)
        conn.executemany("UPDATE agent_flags SET delivered_at = datetime('now') WHERE remediation_id = ?", ids)
    return rows


def recent_remediations(conn: sqlite3.Connection, limit: int = 30) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_remediations ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()


# --- flags --------------------------------------------------------------------

def get_decision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, decision_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_decisions WHERE id = ?", (decision_id,)).fetchone()


def insert_flag(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, decision_id: int | None, turn_id: int | None, actor_id: str,
                reason: str, remediation_id: int | None) -> int:
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO agent_flags (decision_id, turn_id, actor_id, reason, remediation_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (decision_id, turn_id, actor_id, reason, remediation_id),
    )
    return int(cur.lastrowid)


def list_flags(conn: sqlite3.Connection, limit: int = 30) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_flags ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()


# --- repositories ------------------------------------------------------------

def ensure_repo(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, path: str) -> sqlite3.Row:
    conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO agent_repos (repo, path) VALUES (?, ?)", (repo, path))
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_repos WHERE repo = ?", (repo,)).fetchone()

"""Coding-agent licenses, decisions and turns. The caller commits."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3


# --- licenses ----------------------------------------------------------------

def get_license(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str, *, principal: str = "main") -> sqlite3.Row:
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO agent_licenses (repo, principal, action_class) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (repo, principal, action_class),
    )
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_licenses WHERE repo = ? AND principal = ? AND action_class = ?",
        (repo, principal, action_class),
    ).fetchone()


def effective_license(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str, principal: str,
                     *, max_level: int = 1, create: bool = True) -> dict:
    """Return a principal's license, inheriting the repo license at a ceiling.

    Main-agent rows are the source of truth for the repository. A subagent gets
    its own row once it has evidence; before that, it inherits the main row but
    can never exceed ``max_level``.
    """
    if principal == "main":
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM agent_licenses WHERE repo = ? AND principal = 'main' AND action_class = ?",
            (repo, action_class),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is not None:
            return dict(row)
        if create:
            return dict(get_license(conn, repo, action_class))
        return {"repo": repo, "principal": "main", "action_class": action_class,
                "level": 0, "successes": 0, "failures": 0, "successes_at_level": 0,
                "demoted_from": None, "updated_at": None}
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_licenses WHERE repo = ? AND principal = ? AND action_class = ?",
        (repo, principal, action_class),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is not None:
        result = dict(row)
        result["level"] = min(int(result["level"]), max_level)
        return result
    inherited_row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_licenses WHERE repo = ? AND principal = 'main' AND action_class = ?",
        (repo, action_class),
    ).fetchone()
    if inherited_row is None and create:
        inherited_row = get_license(conn, repo, action_class, principal="main")
    inherited = dict(inherited_row) if inherited_row is not None else {
        "repo": repo, "principal": "main", "action_class": action_class,
        "level": 0, "successes": 0, "failures": 0, "successes_at_level": 0,
        "demoted_from": None, "updated_at": None,
    }
    inherited["principal"] = principal
    inherited["level"] = min(int(inherited["level"]), max_level)
    return inherited


def list_licenses(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    if repo is None:
        return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_licenses ORDER BY repo, principal, action_class").fetchall()
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_licenses WHERE repo = ? ORDER BY principal, action_class", (repo,)
    ).fetchall()


def add_evidence(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str, *, ok: bool,
                 principal: str = "main") -> None:
    get_license(conn, repo, action_class, principal=principal)  # create the row on first evidence
    change = ("successes = successes + 1, successes_at_level = successes_at_level + 1"
              if ok else "failures = failures + 1")
    conn.execute(
        f"UPDATE agent_licenses SET {change}, updated_at = datetime('now') "
        "WHERE repo = ? AND principal = ? AND action_class = ?",
        (repo, principal, action_class),
    )


def set_level(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str, level: int,
              *, demoted_from: int | None = None, principal: str = "main") -> None:
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE agent_licenses SET level = ?, demoted_from = ?, successes_at_level = 0, "
        "updated_at = datetime('now') "
        "WHERE repo = ? AND principal = ? AND action_class = ?",
        (level, demoted_from, repo, principal, action_class),
    )


# --- approved command families --------------------------------------------------

def approve_pattern(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str, pattern: str) -> None:
    conn.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO agent_patterns (repo, action_class, pattern, approvals) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)
        ON CONFLICT (repo, pattern) DO UPDATE SET approvals = approvals + 1
        """,
        (repo, action_class, pattern),
    )


def pattern_approved(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT approvals FROM agent_patterns WHERE repo = ? AND pattern = ?", (repo, pattern)
    ).fetchone()
    return bool(row and row["approvals"] > 0)


def forget_patterns(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, action_class: str) -> None:
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM agent_patterns WHERE repo = ? AND action_class = ?", (repo, action_class))


# --- decisions -------------------------------------------------------------

DECISION_COLUMNS = frozenset({
    "session_id", "agent", "principal", "turn_id", "repo", "tool_name", "action_class", "pattern", "command",
    "decision", "decided_by", "level", "source", "reason", "outcome", "trace_id",
})


def insert_decision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, **fields) -> int:
    """Column names come only from this fixed list; values are always bound."""
    unknown = set(fields) - DECISION_COLUMNS
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown agent_decisions columns: {sorted(unknown)}")
    keys = ", ".join(fields)
    marks = ", ".join("?" for _ in fields)
    cur = conn.execute(f"INSERT INTO agent_decisions ({keys}) VALUES ({marks})", tuple(fields.values()))
    return int(cur.lastrowid)


def pending_decision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str, tool_name: str, command: str,
                     *, principal: str = "main") -> sqlite3.Row | None:
    """The latest gate decision this tool run belongs to (PermissionRequest
    carries no tool_use_id, so the session, tool and command identify it)."""
    return conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT * FROM agent_decisions
         WHERE session_id = ? AND principal = ? AND tool_name = ? AND command = ? AND outcome = 'pending'
         ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
        """,
        (session_id, principal, tool_name, command),
    ).fetchone()


def set_outcome(conn: sqlite3.Connection, decision_id: int, outcome: str, *, decided_by: str | None = None) -> None:
    if decided_by:
        conn.execute("UPDATE agent_decisions SET outcome = ?, decided_by = ? WHERE id = ?",
                     (outcome, decided_by, decision_id))
    else:
        conn.execute("UPDATE agent_decisions SET outcome = ? WHERE id = ?", (outcome, decision_id))


def decisions_for_turn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_decisions WHERE turn_id = ? ORDER BY id", (turn_id,)).fetchall()


def recent_decisions(conn: sqlite3.Connection, limit: int = 50) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_decisions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()


# --- turns ---------------------------------------------------------------

def open_turn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, session_id: str, repo: str, cwd: str, prompt: str,
              base_ref: str | None, trace_id: str | None, agent: str = "claude-code",
              principal: str = "main") -> int:
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO agent_turns (session_id, agent, principal, repo, cwd, prompt, base_ref, trace_id) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (session_id, agent, principal, repo, cwd, prompt, base_ref, trace_id),
    )
    return int(cur.lastrowid)


def current_turn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_turns WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1", (session_id,)
    ).fetchone()


TURN_CLOSE_COLUMNS = frozenset({"status", "reason", "scope_score", "lines_changed", "files_changed", "tests"})


def close_turn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int, **fields) -> None:
    """Column names come only from this fixed list; values are always bound."""
    unknown = set(fields) - TURN_CLOSE_COLUMNS
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown agent_turns columns: {sorted(unknown)}")
    sets = ", ".join(f"{k} = ?" for k in fields)
    conn.execute(f"UPDATE agent_turns SET {sets}, closed_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?",
                 (*fields.values(), turn_id))


def note_block(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int, reason: str) -> None:
    """Remember why a turn was sent back; it stays open to be checked again."""
    conn.execute("UPDATE agent_turns SET reason = ?, scope_score = scope_score WHERE id = ?", (reason, turn_id))


def set_checkpoint(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int, checkpoint_id: str) -> None:
    conn.execute("UPDATE agent_turns SET entire_checkpoint = ? WHERE id = ?", (checkpoint_id, turn_id))


def get_turn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_turns WHERE id = ?", (turn_id,)).fetchone()


def agents_seen(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    """Each coding agent that has called the gate, and when it last did."""
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT agent, COUNT(*) AS decisions, MAX(created_at) AS last_seen "
        "FROM agent_decisions GROUP BY agent ORDER BY last_seen DESC"
    ).fetchall()


def recent_turns(conn: sqlite3.Connection, limit: int = 30) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_turns ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()


# --- events ------------------------------------------------------------------

def insert_event(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, repo: str, action_class: str, kind: str, from_level: int,
                 to_level: int, reason: str, actor_id: str, principal: str = "main",
                 trace_id: str | None = None, entire_checkpoint: str | None = None) -> int:
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO agent_events (repo, principal, action_class, kind, from_level, to_level, reason, actor_id, "
        "trace_id, entire_checkpoint) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (repo, principal, action_class, kind, from_level, to_level, reason, actor_id, trace_id, entire_checkpoint),
    )
    return int(cur.lastrowid)


def set_event_sha(conn: sqlite3.Connection, event_id: int, git_sha: str) -> None:
    conn.execute("UPDATE agent_events SET git_sha = ? WHERE id = ?", (git_sha, event_id))


def list_events(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str | None = None, limit: int = 60) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    if repo is None:
        return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_events WHERE repo = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (repo, limit)
    ).fetchall()


# --- remediations --------------------------------------------------------------

def queue_remediation(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, session_id: str, turn_id: int | None, kind: str, text: str,
                      delivered: bool = False) -> int:
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO agent_remediations (session_id, turn_id, kind, text, delivered_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, CASE WHEN ? THEN datetime('now') END)",
        (session_id, turn_id, kind, text, int(delivered)),
    )
    return int(cur.lastrowid)


def take_remediations(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    """The session's queued remediations, oldest first, marked delivered."""
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM agent_remediations WHERE session_id = ? AND delivered_at IS NULL ORDER BY id", (session_id,)
    ).fetchall()
    if rows:
        ids = [(r["id"],) for r in rows]
        conn.executemany("UPDATE agent_remediations SET delivered_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?", ids)
        conn.executemany("UPDATE agent_flags SET delivered_at = datetime('now') WHERE remediation_id = ?", ids)
    return rows


def recent_remediations(conn: sqlite3.Connection, limit: int = 30) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_remediations ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()


# --- flags --------------------------------------------------------------------

def get_decision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, decision_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_decisions WHERE id = ?", (decision_id,)).fetchone()


def insert_flag(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, decision_id: int | None, turn_id: int | None, actor_id: str,
                reason: str, remediation_id: int | None) -> int:
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO agent_flags (decision_id, turn_id, actor_id, reason, remediation_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (decision_id, turn_id, actor_id, reason, remediation_id),
    )
    return int(cur.lastrowid)


def list_flags(conn: sqlite3.Connection, limit: int = 30) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_flags ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()


# --- repositories ------------------------------------------------------------

def ensure_repo(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, path: str) -> sqlite3.Row:
    conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO agent_repos (repo, path) VALUES (?, ?)", (repo, path))
    return conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_repos WHERE repo = ?", (repo,)).fetchone()


def set_last_tests(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, result: str) -> None:
    conn.execute("UPDATE agent_repos SET last_tests = ? WHERE repo = ?", (result, repo))


def set_test_command(conn: sqlite3.Connection, repo: str, command: str | None) -> None:
    conn.execute("UPDATE agent_repos SET test_command = ? WHERE repo = ?", (command or None, repo))

---GATE SEGMENTS---

Claude Code calls its hooks over HTTP; the agent cannot skip them:

* ``UserPromptSubmit`` opens a *turn*: the request and a snapshot of the
  working tree, so the end of the turn can be checked against both.
* ``PreToolUse`` fires before every call, even with permissions bypassed:
  forbidden actions and loop stops are denied there, everything else passes.
* ``PermissionRequest`` fires only when Claude Code would show a prompt, so
  edits and reads that are already allowed never reach us. The call is
  classified into an action class and answered from that class's license in
  this repo: ``allow`` (earned), ``deny`` (never allowed) or no decision, which
  lets Claude Code ask the person as usual.
* ``PostToolUse`` / ``PostToolUseFailure`` report what happened. A tool that
  ran after we left the decision to the person means the person approved it;
  that approval is remembered for its command family. A failed action that
  changes things is evidence against its class and takes its level away.
* ``Stop`` closes the turn: actions that changed the repo become verified
  evidence only if the turn's checks pass (:mod:`verify`).

Every decision is a span (neatlogs + local mirror), every level change is a
git commit in the license ledger.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable

from sololicense.coding import agents, entire, jev, loops, remediation
from sololicense.coding import policy as policy_mod
from sololicense.coding.actions import ACTION_CLASSES, Classification, classify_tool, describe, edited_path
from sololicense.coding.ladder import CodingLadder
from sololicense.db.repositories import agent as agent_repo
from sololicense.observability.tracer import Trace, Tracer
from sololicense.services.git_ledger import GitLedger, LedgerEntry

# Classes whose non-zero exit is information, not a mistake: a failing test
# run is the agent doing its job.
DIAGNOSTIC = {"read", "test-run", "lint-format", "build"}
GATE_ACTOR = "system:coding-gate"
# Denied attempts in one turn after which the agent is stopped, not just refused.
INTERRUPT_AFTER_DENIALS = 3
# Decisions whose action actually ran, so a flagged turn holds them to account.
FLAGGABLE_OUTCOMES = ("ran", "verified", "observed", "failed")
# Asked before they run at L0 even with permissions bypassed. Unrecognised
# commands are not: in bypass mode that would prompt for nearly everything.
ASK_FIRST = frozenset({"file-delete", "deploy", "db-migrate"})


def _who(repo: str, agent: str = "", principal: str = "main") -> dict:
    """Attributes every span of a coding trace carries."""
    return {"repo": repo, "principal": principal, **({"agent": agent} if agent else {})}


def _principal(event: dict | None) -> str:
    """Read the trusted principal set by the native-hook normaliser."""
    return str((event or {}).get("_principal") or (event or {}).get("principal") or "main")


def turn_reason(conn: sqlite3.Connection, turn_id: int) -> str | None:
    row = agent_repo.get_turn(conn, turn_id)
    return row["reason"] if row else None


def _git(cwd: str, *args: str, timeout: float = 10.0) -> str:
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                timeout=timeout, check=False)
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return ""
    return result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""


def repo_of(cwd: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """(display name, root path) of the repository a hook ran in."""
    root = _git(cwd, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel") or cwd
    return Path(root).name or root, root


def snapshot(cwd: str) -> str | None:
    """A commit object of the current working tree (or HEAD if it is clean),
    taken without touching the index, stash list or files."""
    return _git(cwd, "stash", "create") or _git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") or None


@dataclass
class CodingGate:
    conn: sqlite3.Connection
    tracer: Tracer
    ledger: GitLedger
    ladder: CodingLadder = field(default_factory=CodingLadder)
    jev_client: jev.JevClient = field(default_factory=jev.JevClient.from_env)
    # Turn checks (tests + scope); installed by verify.py. Returns (ok, reason, details).
    verifier: Callable[["CodingGate", sqlite3.Row, list[sqlite3.Row]], tuple[bool, str, dict]] | None = None
    # Finds the Entire checkpoint a failed turn can be explained from / rewound to.
    checkpoint_lookup: Callable[[str, str], dict | None] = entire.last_checkpoint
    _traces: dict[int, Trace] = field(default_factory=dict)
    _agent: str = "claude-code"

    # --- hooks ------------------------------------------------------------

    def user_prompt(self, event: dict) -> dict:
        session, cwd = str(event.get("session_id", "")), str(event.get("cwd", "."))
        repo, root = repo_of(cwd)
        agent_repo.ensure_repo(self.conn, repo, root)
        agent = str(event.get("_agent") or "claude-code")
        principal = _principal(event)
        trace = self.tracer.start_trace("coding.turn", defaults=_who(repo, agent, principal), session_id=session or None,
                                        session=session[:12])
        turn_id = agent_repo.open_turn(
            self.conn, session_id=session, repo=repo, cwd=root,
            prompt=str(event.get("prompt", ""))[:8000], base_ref=snapshot(root), trace_id=trace.trace_id,
            agent=agent, principal=principal,
        )
        self._traces[turn_id] = trace
        if not event.get("_implicit"):  # a turn opened for an agent without a prompt hook is not a person
            loops.clear_halt(self.conn, session)
        trace.span("turn.start", turn=turn_id, prompt=str(event.get("prompt", ""))[:300])
        answer: dict = {}
        if agent in agents.TAKES_CONTEXT:
            queued = agent_repo.take_remediations(self.conn, session)
            if queued:
                text = "\n\n".join(r["text"] for r in queued)
                trace.span("remediation.delivered", turn=turn_id, count=len(queued), text=text[:300],
                           kinds=",".join(r["kind"] for r in queued))
                answer = {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": text}}
        self.conn.commit()
        return answer

    def subagent_start(self, event: dict) -> dict:
        """Open an implicit turn and give a subagent its bounded license."""
        session, cwd = str(event.get("session_id", "")), str(event.get("cwd", "."))
        repo, root = repo_of(cwd)
        principal = _principal(event)
        agent_type = str(event.get("subagent_type") or principal.removeprefix("subagent:") or "unknown")
        rules = policy_mod.effective(self.conn, repo, root)
        if agent_type.lower() in {t.lower() for t in rules.subagent_deny_types}:
            reason = f"Blocked: this repo's policy forbids spawning subagent type '{agent_type}'."
            return {"decision": "deny", "reason": reason}
        self.user_prompt({**event, "prompt": "", "_implicit": True, "_principal": principal})
        summary = self._subagent_summary(repo, root, principal, rules)
        return {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SubagentStart", "additionalContext": summary}}

    def subagent_stop(self, event: dict) -> dict:
        """Run the normal turn verifier for a subagent's isolated work."""
        return self.stop(event)

    def _subagent_summary(self, repo: str, root: str, principal: str, rules: policy_mod.Policy) -> str:
        levels = []
        for key, spec in ACTION_CLASSES.items():
            if key == "unknown":
                continue
            license_row = agent_repo.effective_license(self.conn, repo, key, principal,
                                                       max_level=rules.subagent_max, create=False)
            level = min(int(license_row["level"]), rules.ceilings[key])
            levels.append(f"{key}=L{level}")
        return (f"Solo License: {principal} starts with a lower trust ceiling in {repo}. "
                f"Work within these levels: {', '.join(levels)}. "
                "Actions outside the ceiling ask a person; do not push or change protected policy.")

    def pre_tool(self, event: dict) -> dict:
        """Claude Code's PreToolUse fires before every call in every permission
        mode, bypass included, where PermissionRequest may never fire. Only what
        no mode may skip is answered here: a forbidden action or a loop stop is
        denied (and recorded by :meth:`permission`, once: a denied call never
        reaches PermissionRequest); a freeze, or a deletion, deploy or migration
        at L0, asks (recorded by the PermissionRequest that follows). Anything
        else gets no decision and nothing is written, so PermissionRequest and
        the earned levels decide."""
        session, cwd = str(event.get("session_id", "")), str(event.get("cwd", "."))
        tool, tool_input = str(event.get("tool_name", "")), event.get("tool_input") or {}
        repo, root = repo_of(cwd)
        principal = _principal(event)
        result = classify_tool(tool, tool_input)
        rules = policy_mod.effective(self.conn, repo, root)
        subagent_denial = policy_mod.denied_subagent(rules, tool, tool_input)
        repeats = loops.seen(self.conn, session, loops.fingerprint(tool, tool_input)).count + 1
        if (result.hard_deny or subagent_denial or policy_mod.denied(rules, tool, tool_input, root)
                or loops.halted(self.conn, session) or repeats >= loops.STOP_AT):
            answer = self.permission({**event, "_hook": "PreToolUse"})
            decision = (answer.get("hookSpecificOutput") or {}).get("decision") or {}
            reason = str(decision.get("message", "")) or answer.get("systemMessage", "")
            out: dict = {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny",
                                                "permissionDecisionReason": reason},
                         "systemMessage": answer.get("systemMessage", reason)}
            if decision.get("interrupt"):
                out.update({"continue": False, "stopReason": reason})
            return out
        if rules.freeze and result.action_class != "read":
            return self._pre_tool_ask(f"Frozen by policy ({rules.source}): every action asks.")
        if result.action_class in ASK_FIRST:
            key = result.action_class
            # Read without creating the license row: a pass-through or an ask writes nothing.
            lic = agent_repo.effective_license(self.conn, repo, key, principal,
                                               max_level=rules.subagent_max, create=False)
            if min(int(lic["level"]), rules.ceilings[key]) < 1:
                spec = ACTION_CLASSES[key]
                return self._pre_tool_ask(f"{spec.label} always needs a person." if spec.max_level == 0
                                          else f"{spec.label} is at L0 in {repo}: a person decides.")
        return {}

    @staticmethod
    def _pre_tool_ask(reason: str) -> dict:
        return {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "ask",
                                       "permissionDecisionReason": f"Solo License: {reason}"}}

    def tool_result(self, event: dict, *, failed: bool) -> dict:
        session = str(event.get("session_id", ""))
        tool, tool_input = str(event.get("tool_name", "")), event.get("tool_input") or {}
        loop_note, halt = self._watch_loops(session, tool, tool_input, event, failed)
        row = agent_repo.pending_decision(self.conn, session, tool, describe(tool, tool_input),
                                          principal=_principal(event))
        if row is None:  # never went through the gate (already allowed by settings)
            self.conn.commit()
            return self._with_loop_note({}, loop_note, halt, failed)
        turn = agent_repo.current_turn(self.conn, session)
        trace = self._trace(turn)
        repo, key = row["repo"], row["action_class"]
        # Trust only grows from a person's yes or from the gate's own earned
        # "allow". An action the *agent's* settings let through (its hook fires
        # on every call, so nobody was asked) is observed, never credited.
        unattended = row["decision"] == "ask" and row["decided_by"] == "agent-settings"
        if row["decision"] == "ask" and not unattended:  # it ran, so the person said yes
            agent_repo.approve_pattern(self.conn, repo, key, row["pattern"])
            agent_repo.set_outcome(self.conn, row["id"], "pending", decided_by="person")
            trace.span("gate.approved_by_person", decision_id=row["id"], pattern=row["pattern"], action_class=key)
        error = str(event.get("error", ""))[:300]
        answer: dict = {}
        if failed and key not in DIAGNOSTIC and not event.get("is_interrupt"):
            # A failure always counts, whoever let the action run.
            agent_repo.set_outcome(self.conn, row["id"], "failed")
            trace.span("tool.failed", status="error", decision_id=row["id"], action_class=key, error=error)
            why = f"{row['command']} failed: {error.splitlines()[0] if error else 'error'}"
            was = self._fail(repo, key, why, trace, turn=turn, principal=row["principal"])
            checkpoint = self._checkpoint_for(turn) if was > 0 else None
            answer = self._remedy_failed_tool(row, tool_input, demoted=was > 0, trace=trace, reason=why,
                                              level=was, checkpoint=checkpoint)
        elif unattended:
            agent_repo.set_outcome(self.conn, row["id"], "observed")
            trace.span("tool.observed", decision_id=row["id"], action_class=key,
                       note="ran under the agent's own settings; not credited")
        elif key in DIAGNOSTIC:
            agent_repo.set_outcome(self.conn, row["id"], "verified")
            trace.span("tool.ran", decision_id=row["id"], action_class=key, exit="error" if failed else "ok")
            self._succeed(repo, key, trace, principal=row["principal"])
        else:  # changed the repo: evidence once the turn's checks pass
            agent_repo.set_outcome(self.conn, row["id"], "ran")
            trace.span("tool.ran", decision_id=row["id"], action_class=key, exit="ok")
        self.conn.commit()
        return self._with_loop_note(answer, loop_note, halt, failed)

    def _watch_loops(self, session: str, tool: str, tool_input: dict, event: dict,
                     failed: bool) -> tuple[str, bool]:
        """Count a call that ran; (guidance for the agent or "", halt it)."""
        if event.get("is_interrupt"):
            return "", False
        turn = agent_repo.current_turn(self.conn, session)
        if loops.is_edit(tool):
            loops.record_edit(self.conn, session, turn["id"] if turn else None, edited_path(tool_input))
        seen = loops.record(self.conn, session, loops.fingerprint(tool, tool_input), failed=failed,
                            error=str(event.get("error", "")))
        command = describe(tool, tool_input)
        if seen.count >= loops.STOP_AT:
            kind, halt = "loop-stop", True
        elif failed and seen.failures >= loops.SAME_FAILURE_AT:
            kind, halt = "same-failure", False
        elif seen.count >= loops.WARN_AT:
            kind, halt = "repeat", False
        else:
            return "", False
        text = remediation.compose(kind, command=command, reason=seen.error, attempts=seen.count).text
        if halt:
            loops.halt(self.conn, session, text)
        self._trace(turn).span("detection.loop", status="error", severity="critical" if halt else "warning",
                               kind=kind, command=command, repeats=seen.count, failures=seen.failures,
                               action_class=classify_tool(tool, tool_input).action_class,
                               reason=text.removeprefix("Solo License: "), interrupt=halt)
        return text, halt

    @staticmethod
    def _with_loop_note(answer: dict, note: str, halt: bool, failed: bool) -> dict:
        if not note:
            return answer
        out = answer.setdefault("hookSpecificOutput", {
            "hookEventName": "PostToolUseFailure" if failed else "PostToolUse"})
        out["additionalContext"] = "\n\n".join(t for t in (out.get("additionalContext"), note) if t)
        if halt:  # nobody was asked before this run, so stop the agent after it
            answer.update({"continue": False, "stopReason": note})
        return answer

    def _remedy_failed_tool(self, row: sqlite3.Row, tool_input: dict, *, demoted: bool, trace: Trace,
                            reason: str, level: int, checkpoint: str | None) -> dict:
        """Tell the agent, next to the failed tool's result, what to undo. Claude
        Code's PostToolUseFailure takes only ``additionalContext`` (it cannot block)."""
        path = edited_path(tool_input)
        fix = remediation.compose("tool-failed", action_class=row["action_class"], command=row["command"],
                                  files=(path,) if path else (), demoted=demoted, checkpoint=checkpoint)
        delivered = row["agent"] in agents.TAKES_CONTEXT
        if delivered:
            agent_repo.queue_remediation(self.conn, session_id=row["session_id"], turn_id=row["turn_id"],
                                         kind="tool-failed", text=fix.text, delivered=True)
        trace.span("remediation.sent", status="error", kind="tool-failed", decision_id=row["id"],
                   action_class=row["action_class"], revert=list(fix.revert_commands), delivered=delivered,
                   reason=reason, from_level=level, to_level=0 if demoted else level,
                   entire_checkpoint=checkpoint or "")
        return {
            "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUseFailure", "additionalContext": fix.text},
            "systemMessage": f"Solo License: {row['action_class']} "
                             f"{'is back to asking' if demoted else 'still asks'} after `{row['command']}` failed.",
        }

    def stop(self, event: dict) -> dict:
        session = str(event.get("session_id", ""))
        loops.clear_halt(self.conn, session)
        turn = agent_repo.current_turn(self.conn, session)
        if turn is None or turn["status"] != "open":
            self.conn.commit()
            return {}
        trace = self._trace(turn)
        decisions = agent_repo.decisions_for_turn(self.conn, turn["id"])
        ok, reason, details = (True, "", {})
        if self.verifier is not None:
            ok, reason, details = self.verifier(self, turn, decisions)
        retrying = bool(event.get("stop_hook_active"))
        changed = [d for d in decisions if d["outcome"] == "ran"]
        demoted: list[str] = []
        checkpoint_id = None
        principal = str(turn["principal"] or "main") if turn else "main"
        if ok:
            for d in changed:
                agent_repo.set_outcome(self.conn, d["id"], "verified")
                self._succeed(d["repo"], d["action_class"], trace, principal=principal)
        else:
            checkpoint_id = self._checkpoint_for(turn, fresh=True)
            evidence = reason
            if checkpoint_id:
                details["entire_checkpoint"] = checkpoint_id
                evidence = f"{reason}\nEntire: {entire.explain_command(checkpoint_id)}"
            for key in sorted({d["action_class"] for d in changed} | set(details.get("blame", ()))):
                if self._fail(turn["repo"], key, evidence, trace, checkpoint=checkpoint_id,
                              principal=principal) > 0:
                    demoted.append(key)
            for d in changed:
                agent_repo.set_outcome(self.conn, d["id"], "failed")
        measured = {k: v for k, v in details.items() if k != "blame"}
        if not ok and not retrying:
            # Send the agent back to fix it; the turn stays open and is checked again.
            fix = remediation.compose("turn-failed", reason=reason, files=self._turn_files(turn),
                                      base_ref=turn["base_ref"], checkpoint=checkpoint_id, classes=demoted)
            trace.span("turn.blocked", status="error", turn=turn["id"], reason=reason, **measured)
            trace.span("remediation.sent", status="error", kind="turn-failed", turn=turn["id"],
                       revert=list(fix.revert_commands), reason=reason, classes=demoted,
                       entire_checkpoint=checkpoint_id or "")
            agent_repo.note_block(self.conn, turn["id"], reason)
            agent_repo.queue_remediation(self.conn, session_id=session, turn_id=turn["id"], kind="turn-failed",
                                         text=fix.text, delivered=True)
            self.conn.commit()
            return {"decision": "block", "reason": fix.text}
        thrash = loops.thrashed(self.conn, session, turn["id"]) if ok and not retrying else []
        if thrash:
            # Guidance, not evidence: sent back once, no level changes.
            text = remediation.compose("edit-thrash", files=thrash).text
            trace.span("detection.edit_thrash", status="error", severity="warning", turn=turn["id"],
                       files=[p for p, _ in thrash], kind="edit-thrash", action_class="file-edit",
                       reason=text.removeprefix("Solo License: "))
            agent_repo.queue_remediation(self.conn, session_id=session, turn_id=turn["id"], kind="edit-thrash",
                                         text=text, delivered=True)
            self.conn.commit()
            return {"decision": "block", "reason": text}
        for d in decisions:
            if d["outcome"] == "pending":  # left to a person who said no
                agent_repo.set_outcome(self.conn, d["id"], "not-run")
        status = "verified" if ok else "failed"
        # A turn that was sent back once keeps that reason, even once fixed.
        agent_repo.close_turn(self.conn, turn["id"], status=status, reason=reason or turn_reason(self.conn, turn["id"]),
                              **{k: details[k] for k in ("scope_score", "lines_changed", "files_changed", "tests")
                                 if k in details})
        trace.span("turn.end", status="ok" if ok else "error", turn=turn["id"], verdict=status,
                   reason=reason, **measured)
        trace.flush(self.conn, None)
        self._traces.pop(turn["id"], None)
        self.conn.commit()
        return {}

    # --- license changes -------------------------------------------------------

    def _succeed(self, repo: str, key: str, trace: Trace, *, principal: str = "main") -> None:
